character.name: Elena
character.role: Brand ambassador for Rise & Ferment / Maiaua Mea
character.seed_prompt: Editorial food photography. Woman in her early 30s, warm brown eyes, shoulder-length wavy ombre hair (dark brown roots to warm caramel tips), side-swept bangs, olive skin with subtle freckles, natural genuine wide smile. Wearing a white cotton t-shirt under a cream linen apron. Standing in a bright kitchen with white cabinets and wooden countertops. Warm natural morning window light, shot on Canon 85mm f/1.4, shallow depth of field, warm color palette. Photorealistic, natural flaws of the face, forehead wrinkles, 1 pimple, editorial quality
